newsitem.title: DENMARK: SOCCER-CLASSY HAESSLER SENDS BRONDBY CRASHING TO DEFEAT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CLASSY HAESSLER SENDS BRONDBY CRASHING TO DEFEAT.

text.p: Karlsruhe ended Brondby's 16-match unbeaten home run in the UEFA Cup when they beat the Danish side 3-1 in the first leg of their third round tie on Tuesday with German international midfielder Thomas Haessler scoring twice.

Haessler drew first blood after 42 minutes and as soon as play restarted a muffed cross by Brondbys Marc Keller put the ball back with the unmarked Haessler, who made a sliding shot through the goalmouth mud, into Brondbys net.

During the second half Brondby had several chances to even the score but repeatedly put the ball over or around the net. Karlsruhes Hassler however showed his class by weaving the ball past the entire Danish defence before passing it to the South-Africasn born Sean Dundee, who tapped it past Jens Krogh with little apparent effort.
It fell to substitute Ruben Bagger to salvage something of the outclassed Brondbys honour in the 89th minute when he scored his teams only goal, his first in the UEFA Cup.
